relationships.subject: XC001
relationships.evidence_quote: Circulating VEGF levels rose transiently after administration of the vector but returned to normal or below normal by the first-month follow-up visit

relationships.subject: XC001
relationships.evidence_quote: XC001 is a novel adenoviral-5 vector designed to express multiple isoforms of VEGF (vascular endothelial growth factor) and more safely and potently induce angiogenesis.

key_findings: Transepicardial XC001 was safe with no SAEs attributed to the study drug in 32 refractory angina patients
Exercise duration, perfusion deficit and angina frequency improved through 12 months in this open-label trial
